notes: Compiled 2026-10-07. Main market data = MSCI factsheets as of 2026-09-30 (USD). Each factsheet was read twice (full extract + verification extract); returns and fundamentals matched in both reads.

Return variant differs by factsheet: net for 18 markets, gross for Hong Kong, France, Switzerland, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia (MSCI did not surface a current net factsheet for these). Korea's 10Y rank (2nd) does not depend on this: the nearest gross market (Canada 11.72) is far below Korea (15.74).
20-year return: 확인 못 함. MSCI factsheets do not print it; the longest common window is 'Since Dec 29, 2000' (net), available for 13 of 25 markets.

Philippines factsheet at the plain URL (msci-philippines-index.pdf) was dated 2026-08-31; the GUID factsheet dated 2026-09-30 is used. Saudi Arabia plain URL was dated 2024-12-31; the GUID factsheet dated 2026-09-30 is used. Malaysia net factsheet was dated 2026-08-31; the gross 2026-09-30 factsheet is used.
MSCI 2026 Market Classification Review (2026-06-23): Korea stays EM, no consultation; Greece EM->DM effective May 2027; Bulgaria standalone->FM; Indonesia and Turkey flagged.

MSCI 2026 Global Market Accessibility Review (June 2026): Korea listed under 'Emerging Markets - Asia Pacific'; one improvement: 'Availability of Investment Instruments' '-' to '+'. Remaining issues named: no deliverable offshore won (24-hour onshore FX planned July 2026, offshore KRW settlement targeted 2027), LEI/IRC coexistence friction, settlement mostly per investor ID, in-kind transfers not common, short-selling operational friction, English disclosure phased through 2027.
Value-up timeline: FSC announced the Corporate Value-up Program 2024-02-26; KRX announced the Korea Value-up Index 2024-09-24 (100 stocks), real-time publication from 2024-09-30.

Commercial Act: 1st amendment passed 2025-07-03 (directors' duty to shareholders; independent directors >= 1/3; e-meetings from 2027-01-01); 2nd passed 2025-08-25 (cumulative voting for listed firms with assets > KRW 2 trillion; >= 2 audit-committee members elected separately); 3rd passed 2026-02-25, promulgated/effective 2026-03-06 (treasury shares cancelled within 1 year of acquisition).

KEIA 2026-07-22: KOSPI nearly doubled in H1 2026 and fell roughly 27% from its 2026-06-19 high by the article date; Samsung Electronics + SK Hynix = 55.5% of KOSPI market cap (22% at end-2023); foreign investors net sold a record KRW 148.3 trillion (USD 96.7 billion) in H1 2026; in May 2026 earnings projections were revised up 48% excluding the two chipmakers and 261% including them.
Rank fields: rank_better_first follows higher_is (1 = best by that direction); rank_desc = 1 for the largest number. Competition ranking for ties. Benchmarks are not ranked.
Neutral data only: no advice, recommendation or forecast.
